card.title: IPad Air 4 Not Reading Touch

claims.statement: iPad Air 4 no touch with a known-good screen: peel the tape over the middle shields to expose a J-shaped cutout and diode-check the caps there; one in the top-left/middle is usually shorted on a touch IC power rail.
Inject 1 V / 1 A; if heat comes from under the neighbouring shield, cut it open to reach a further bank of caps on the same rail. Shorted smoothing caps can be removed without replacement.

procedure: Test with a known-good screen that worked on another iPad.
Diode-check caps in the J cutout.
Inject 1 V / 1 A; cut neighbouring shield if needed; remove hot cap.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
